## 1. Executive Summary

Threshold is a real-time fractal raymarcher whose performance strategy rests on three pillars: **(1) function-constant pipeline specialization** that bakes iteration counts, fractal type, ray-step budgets and Mandelbulb power into per-variant shaders so the Metal compiler fully unrolls and devirtualizes the dominant `Map()` distance-estimator loop; **(2) an orbit cache + analytic-Jacobian shading path** that captures the surface hit state exactly once and reconstructs normals/colors without re-iterating the fractal (eliminating ~70% of redundant inner loops, and for Mandelbox replacing finite-difference normals with zero extra `Map()` calls); and **(3) relaxed (over-relaxed) sphere tracing** with overstep-failure recovery that takes larger-than-conservative march steps to cut DE evaluations on the hot path of every live render.** On top of these, the renderer leans on CPU-precompute of frame-uniform transcendentals, half-precision shading math, early ray/tile termination, and shared shadow evaluation.

Critically, the verification pass reveals that **the most-advertised "exotic" optimizations are largely dormant in the default configuration**: the entire hierarchical 8×8 compute raymarcher (with its temporal reprojection, foveation, coherent-packet, and tile-empty skip) only runs when `tileSize==8`, which no default or bundled scene selects. Likewise MetalFX upscaling, the TAA accumulation kernel, and fragment warm-start all require `resolutionScale < 0.999`, which is not the default. So the **default live path is the per-pixel fragment shader** (`fragmentShaderMono` on Mac, `fragmentShader` on visionOS), where the active levers are pipeline specialization, orbit cache, relaxed tracing, CPU precompute, half-precision shading, early miss-skip, and (on visionOS) hardware foveation via the rasterization rate map. The Buddhabrot subsystem is a separate progressive Monte-Carlo renderer with its own bounded ring-buffer + GPU radix-sort splat pipeline.

## 2. Technique Catalog

### GPU Shader — Algorithmic

**Relaxed (over-relaxed) sphere tracing + overstep-failure retreat** — `Shaders.metal:1200-1214,1282-1312,1346-1374` — Keinert enhanced sphere tracing: `stepLen = h*omega` with `omega=clamp(stepMultiplier,1,cap)`; `relaxedStepUpdate()` detects when unbounding spheres stop overlapping and retreats, pinning `omega=1`. — Fewer `Map()` evals per ray in open space without tunneling thin features. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (all live paths; `stepMultiplier` ramps to 1.4 once geometry settles, briefly inert at `omega==1` cold start).

**Over-relaxation hit-registration guard (`!sorFail`)** — `Shaders.metal:1299,1361` — hit test is `UNLIKELY(h<threshold) && !sorFail`; suppresses false hits on overstepped gaps so the speedup stays artifact-free. — Makes relaxed tracing safe (its absence would force disabling the whole technique). — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Per-fractal-type over-relaxation ceiling (`relaxedOmegaCap`)** — `Shaders.metal:1224-1240` — caps `omega` at 1.4 for box/fold DEs, 1.1 for log-DE Mandelbulb/Julia, 1.2 for Kleinian/custom; folds to a constant when `FC_FRACTAL_TYPE` baked. — Lets safe DE families overstep aggressively while keeping unsafe ones correct. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Adaptive distance-scaled hit threshold + early ray termination** — `Shaders.metal:1289-1307,1352-1369,1180` — threshold grows with `t` via `fma(t,0.0008,0.0005)`; hit returns immediately under `UNLIKELY`. — Distant samples accept hits sooner; early-out ends the march at first surface contact. — **STATUS: ✅ active.** *(The `(1-quality)` widening term is dead — `quality` is hardcoded 1.0 at every call site; only the `fma(t,…)` distance term does work.)*

**Mandelbulb-specific near-start + finer threshold tuning** — `Shaders.metal:1160-1166,1253-1254,1289-1291` — Mandelbulb/Julia start at `t=0.005` (vs 0.05) with ~4× finer threshold because the log-DE returns tiny near-surface values. — Per-type quality-per-ms balance; avoids overshooting thin shells. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Geometry-only DE for shadows (`MapDistOnly`)** — `Shaders.metal:503-521,1618` — stripped `Map` variant dropping orbit-trap/trap-iter/trap-pos/Jacobian, returns distance only. — Saves ~6 ops/fold-iteration on every shadow sample. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (wherever shadows run; `FC_SHADOW_ITERATIONS` unrolling applies on visionOS but not Mac, where it loops on a runtime count — stripping still active).

**Reduced-iteration secondary rays (`ReducedSecondaryIterations`)** — `Shaders.metal:1050-1057` — normals/shadows run at ~1/3 (Mandelbulb) or 2/5 (box-fold) of primary iterations, floored at 2-3. — Cuts secondary-ray inner-loop cost roughly in half-to-third. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (every hit pixel, all live paths).

**Coarse-pass fractional-iteration DE (`MapContinuous` at 0.6× iters)** — `Shaders.metal:544-581,1173-1178` — interpolates between `floor(N)` and `floor(N)+1` folds to smooth the DE so thin features aren't jumped, at 0.6× iteration count. — Cheaper coarse pass that seeds the fine march closer. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — only reached via `SceneCoarse`, i.e. the visionOS compute (tileSize 8) and quad-shared (tileSize 2) paths; **never on the default Mac/visionOS fragment path**.

**Half-precision fold iteration (`MAP_ITERATION_HALF`)** — `Shaders.metal:42-47,559-573` — coarse/continuous DE runs box-fold + sphere-fold in `half` (2× ALU throughput) where the large coarse threshold tolerates fp16. — Doubles coarse-pass fold throughput. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — only inside `MapContinuous` (compute/quad paths) **and only for `fractalType==Mandelbox`**; non-Mandelbox coarse routes to integer `FractalDE_Dispatch`. Not on the default fragment path.

**Half-precision shading accumulation (`half3` color path)** — `Shaders.metal:2129,2216-2245,2562,2616-2624,2872-2880` — col/brightness/shadow/ambient/fog/glow all accumulate in `half`. — 2× ALU + halved register pressure on the shading tail, better occupancy. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (every shaded pixel, both fragment paths and compute).

**Interleaved-gradient-noise march dither** — `Shaders.metal:296-300,1249,1326` — temporally stable IGN offsets each ray's start `t` (×0.015 full / ×0.01 from-start). — Lets fewer march steps avoid banding by deferring smoothing to temporal integration. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (unconditional in both Scene functions). *(The advertised pairing with Halton sub-pixel jitter does NOT hold on the compute path — `jitterOffset` is pinned to zero there.)*

**Quad-shared coarse-leader broadcast (2×2)** — `Shaders.metal:2800-2820` — lane 0 runs `SceneCoarse`, `quad_broadcast`s the start distance to all 4 lanes which fine-march from there; full-march fallback on coarse miss. — ~8-16× fewer coarse DE evals (1 per 4 pixels). — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — visionOS quad-shared pipeline only (`tileSize==2`); dormant by default (tileSize 0).

**Full-screen single-triangle coverage** — `Shaders.metal:2994-3011,3103-3111,3307-3321` (Buddhabrot `307-321`) — resolve/blit/motion passes emit one oversized triangle from `vertexID` (no vertex buffer). — Avoids quad diagonal seam + vertex fetch. — **STATUS: ✅ active** on resolve/blit/motion passes (themselves conditional on their host path running).

### GPU Shader — Control-Flow

**Branch/inline hints (`FORCE_INLINE`, `LIKELY`/`UNLIKELY`)** — `Shaders.metal:12-15`, applied throughout — `always_inline` on `Map`/`Shadow`/helpers; `__builtin_expect` on hit-found and ray-exit tests. — Cross-function optimization + correct branch prediction in the hottest loops. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Early ray-miss branch skips all shading/shadows** — `Shaders.metal:2584-2647,2829-2901` — entire lighting block (normals, 2 shadow marches, color, specular) gated behind `ret.x < kRayMissThreshold (900)`; miss writes only far-depth `1e-7`. — Background/sky pixels skip the most expensive secondary work. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (both fragment paths).

**Front-face culling on inward-facing raymarch box** — `Renderer.swift:1105-1107` — `setCullMode(.front)` so only back faces of the bounding cube rasterize. — Halves rasterized fragments; avoids double-invoking the raymarch fragment. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (live visionOS fragment path, unconditional).

**Safety-bubble strength fast-outs** — `Shaders.metal:411-441` — `applySafetyBubble` early-returns when disabled or `strength<0.001`, and skips the temporal `mix()` when `strength>=1.0`; gate is frame-uniform (divergence-free). — Avoids the bubble SDF + blend in `Map()` (50-100+×/pixel) in the common cases. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (the strength fast-outs run everywhere; default bubble is off so the disabled-branch return dominates).

**Quad-shared shadow rays** — `Shaders.metal:2836-2868` — lane 0 traces spot+sun shadows, `quad_broadcast`s to the other 3 lanes. — ~75% fewer shadow-march DE evals per quad. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — quad-shared pipeline only; there `FC_SHARE_SHADOWS` is **force-baked true**, so the per-pixel fallback is dead code in that pipeline. Path itself requires `tileSize==2`.

**Cel-shading specular skip** — `Shaders.metal:236-240,2216-2239` — `quantizeCelLight` floors lighting; the two Blinn-Phong `powr()` specular evals are skipped when `cellShadingEnabled!=0`. — Skips 2 specular `powr()` per hit pixel. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — default `cellShadingEnabled==0`, so by default `quantizeCelLight` is a no-op AND specular still runs. The saving only materializes when cel-shading is enabled.

**FloorCircle / spring-blob overlays reuse marched distance** — `Shaders.metal:2657-2668,2910-2920` — composite analytic 2D SDFs over the existing `ret.x`; depth recomputed only when visible. — UI overlays cost a few ops instead of extra geometry. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — spring blob active on both platforms (gated by `springVisible`); floor circle is visionOS-only (Mac hardcodes `floorCenterRadius=0` → never draws → latent-dead there).

### Caching / Reuse

**OrbitCache: single-hit orbit state threaded into shading** — `Shaders.metal:829-859`, populated `1303/1365`, consumed by `GetNormal 1099-1153` / `ColourWithScheme 877-914` — march loop uses cheap `MapUnified`; on hit, one `MapWithOrbitCacheUnified` captures p/trap/trapIter/trapPos/Jacobian; shading reads `cache.valid` to skip re-iteration. — Eliminates ~70% of redundant inner loops per pixel. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (default fragment path; complement: the no-Jacobian `MapUnified` loop pays the heavy orbit bookkeeping exactly once per hit).

**Analytic Jacobian normals (zero extra `Map()` for Mandelbox)** — `Shaders.metal:967-998,1103-1111` — accumulates `dF/dp0` as a 3×3 Jacobian through the iteration chain; normal = `normalize(J·normalize(p.xyz))`, no DE probes. — Replaces 3-4 full-iteration finite-difference probes per hit pixel — the largest single shading-stage saving. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — **Mandelbox only** (`hasJacobian` is false for all other types). For Mandelbox (the default scene) it is fully active.

**Mandelbulb cached-escape-direction normal (2 probes)** — `Shaders.metal:1059-1090,1112-1115` — uses cached `cache.p.xyz` as base normal, refines with 2 tangent-space DE probes at reduced iterations, reusing `cache.distance`. — ~5-6× fewer normal-stage iterations for Mandelbulb. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (when Mandelbulb selected).

**Cached center distance as `d0` for finite-difference normals** — `Shaders.metal:1116-1141` — non-Mandelbox cached path reuses `cache.distance` as center, does 3 offset evals at reduced iters via lean `FractalDE_Dispatch`. — 4-call gradient → 3 reduced-iteration calls. — **STATUS: ✅ active for non-Mandelbox** (Menger/Kleinian/etc.). The Mandelbox sub-branch (1116-1128) is 💀 latent-dead — every Mandelbox cache sets `hasJacobian=true`, so `GetNormal` always takes the Jacobian path first.

**Color from cached orbit trap** — `Shaders.metal:863-914` — when `cache.valid`, reads trap/trapIter/trapPos straight from cache and skips the `FC_COLOR_ITERATIONS` color fold loop. — Eliminates one full color-iteration loop per hit pixel. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Shared per-tile shadows (1 eval → 64 lanes)** — `Shaders.metal:2151-2213` — thread 0 computes spot+sun `Shadow()` into `tg_shaSpot/tg_shaSun`, broadcast after barrier. — Saves ~63 `Shadow()` evals (~2600+ fold loops) per tile. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — compute 8×8 path only; `FC_SHARE_SHADOWS` is never baked there, so it falls to the runtime `lightingSoftness<0.9` heuristic (default 0.35 → on). Whole path requires `tileSize==8`.

### Pipeline Specialization

**FC_FRACTAL_ITERATIONS DE-loop unroll** — `Shaders.metal:67,483-487`; `RendererPipelineHelpers.swift:106-111` — bakes the inner fold-loop bound as a compile-time constant for full unroll. — The single biggest hot-path ALU lever (`Map()` runs 50-100+×/pixel). — **STATUS: ✅ active** on Mac (index 0) + visionOS presets + every steady-state compute pipeline. Generic cold-start fallback runs unbaked one frame.

**FC_FRACTAL_TYPE dispatch devirtualization** — `Shaders.metal:86,591-628`; `RendererPipelineHelpers.swift:124-126` — collapses the runtime DE switch to one direct call and dead-strips ~11 unused estimators. — Removes per-sample dispatch branch; shrinks variant + register pressure. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (Mac + visionOS exact pipelines; runtime branch on cold/generic fallback frames).

**FC_MAX_RAY_STEPS baked march bound** — `Shaders.metal:83,1274,1332` — bakes `baseMaxSteps`; outer loop does **not** fully unroll (runtime scaling), so gain is bounds specialization/constant-folding. — Bounds the dominant outer loop per preset. — **STATUS: ✅ active** on Mac + visionOS fragment + compute. *(The `*quality` runtime multiplier is inert — `quality` always 1.0.)*

**FC_MANDELBULB_POWER fastPowR DCE** — `Shaders.metal:103`; `RendererPipelineHelpers.swift:90-100`; `RaymarchRenderView.swift:600-609` — bakes integer power in `{2,3,4,5,6,8,10,12,16}` so `fastPowR` constant-folds and dead-strips wrong-power branches. — Replaces runtime `powr()`/branch in the Mandelbulb inner loop. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — Mandelbulb + whitelisted integer power only; nil (runtime) otherwise.

**FC_NEON_MODE_ENABLED orbit-trap DCE** — `Shaders.metal:90,918-920` — compiles out neon orbit-trap coloring when false; keys neon-on/off pipelines separately. — Removes per-pixel neon bookkeeping for non-neon configs. — **STATUS: ✅ active** on visionOS fragment (baked concrete); 🟡 runtime-gated on Mac (Mac never sets index 8).

**FC_COLOR_ITERATIONS color-loop unroll** — `Shaders.metal:93,873-898` — bakes color iteration count. — Unrolls the color fold loop — but only on the rare cache-**miss** path (cache hits skip the loop). — **STATUS: ✅ active** (baked on Mac + visionOS), benefit realized only on misses.

**FC_QUALITY_MODE feature-degradation bake** — `Shaders.metal:76,1591`; `RendererPipelineHelpers.swift:115-117` — bakes quality tier (0/1/2) driving shadow step count/range and full-skip. — Constant-folds per-quality shadow toggles. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — set only on visionOS fragment presets; **undefined on Mac and compute (→ 0, full shadows)**.

**FC_SHADOWS_ENABLED compile-out** — `Shaders.metal:99,1588-1589`; `RendererPipelineHelpers.swift:167` — `Shadow()` returns flat 0.35 with zero `Map()` when baked false. — Removes the entire secondary shadow march. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — baked false **only** on the visionOS `QualityPreset.low` startup-shared fragment pipeline. Per-FT and per-preset pipelines keep shadows on; Mac and compute can never compile shadows out via this FC.

**FC_SAFETY_BUBBLE_ENABLED scene bake** — `Shaders.metal:73,411-414`; `RendererPipelineCache.swift:80-92` — baked into FC index 2 on exact `_B0/_B1` keys (Mandelbulb force-disabled); shared/Mac pipelines fall back to runtime `params.bubbleEnabled`. — Dead-strips the bubble SDF when off. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — default bubble is off, so by default it strips an already-disabled feature.

**FC_SHARE_SHADOWS forced-on (quad-shared)** — `Shaders.metal:96,2151,2836`; `RendererPipelineHelpers.swift:42-49` — force-set true only for `fragmentShaderQuadShared`. — Guarantees 1 shadow eval per 2×2 quad with no per-pixel branch. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — active within the quad-shared path (`tileSize==2`), dormant by default.

**FC_WARM_START fragment warm-start specialization** — `Shaders.metal:108-109,2566-2580,2727`; `RendererPipelineHelpers.swift:50-57` — force-baked true for the visionOS `fragmentShader` pipeline; function-constant-gated prev-depth texture argument is stripped on Mac/screenshot. — Compiles in the warm-start path + texture binding only where used. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — FC compiled into the default visionOS pipeline (texture-arg cost-avoidance real), but the actual warm-march only triggers when MetalFX is active (`resolutionScale<0.999`) + geometry stable. Fully compiled out on Mac.

**FC_COHERENT_PACKET compute bake** — `Shaders.metal:116,1846-1847`; `RendererPipelineCache.swift:735-737` — bakes the predict-validate vs legacy branch on exact compute keys. — DCEs the unused branch. — **STATUS: ⛔ disabled** — set only on the compute kernel (off by default, `tileSize≠8`) AND `coherentPacketEnabled` defaults false. Doubly off.

**FC_DEBUG_HIERARCHICAL compile-out** — `Shaders.metal:2258-2287` — debug tint + packet overlay DCE'd when baked false. — Removes per-pixel debug branching in release. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — `debug=false` baked on specialized compute pipelines; the generic empty-constants fallback keeps it a runtime branch (still false).

**Mac/iOS Mutex-backed `fragmentShaderMono` cache** — `MacSpecializedPipelineCache.swift:18-51`; `RaymarchRenderView.swift:617-709` — synchronous per-frame read; async build bakes FC 0,6,7,9,12; generic pipeline used until ready. — Brings loop-unroll + DE-devirtualization to Mac/iOS without a render-thread stall. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Shared-quality fallback pipelines (FC_FRACTAL_TYPE omitted)** — `RendererPipelineCache.swift:60-61,603-629`; `Renderer.swift:381-430` — prebuilds iterations/raysteps/quality-keyed pipelines (Map unrolls, DE dispatch stays runtime) to cover the first frame after a fractal-type change. — Partially-specialized coverage avoids both a sync compile and the fully-generic pipeline. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Async off-actor pipeline compilation + fallback ladder** — `RendererPipelineCache.swift:500-507,888-897,996-1094` — exact pipeline built in a detached `.utility` Task; current frame served from best fallback (neon-off → shared-exact → shared-neon-off → generic). — Eliminates 50-500ms render-thread hitches on first sight of a config. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Bounded in-flight builds + exponential-backoff retry dedup** — `RendererPipelineCache.swift:5-13,925-933,956-990` — caps concurrent background builds at 3, drops duplicate keys, backs off failed builds 0.25s→4s. — Prevents compile storms / thermal spikes / per-frame retry of failing keys. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Specialization-key dedup at startup** — `RendererPipelineCache.swift:348-397` — `Set<String>` of compiled render + prewarmed compute keys skips presets that collapse to identical configs. — Cuts launch warm-up time/memory (50-500ms per dup avoided). — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Cached default MTLLibrary** — `RendererPipelineHelpers.swift:5-10` — memoizes `makeDefaultLibrary()` in a static. — Removes redundant metallib loads across many variant builds. — **STATUS: ✅ active** on visionOS (note: Mac `RaymarchRenderView.swift:662` calls `makeDefaultLibrary()` directly — small missed reuse).

**Fast-math compile option for custom formulas** — `CustomShaderCompiler.swift:132-140` — `mathMode=.fast`/`fastMathEnabled` on runtime `.threshfx` libraries. — Faster low-precision transcendentals in custom DE loops. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (custom formulas).

**Hash-namespaced custom-shader cache (MRU 4) + stale-build rejection** — `RendererCustomShader.swift:79-82,150-185`; `RendererPipelineCache.swift:919-947` — keys custom pipelines `CX{hash}_`, retains 4 most-recent, drops builds whose hash no longer matches active. — A/B-ing two custom formulas becomes a cache hit, not a recompile. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

### Resolution & Upscaling

**Sub-native render + MetalFX spatial upscale (visionOS stereo)** — `MetalFXManager.swift:196-216`; `RendererRenderSupport.swift:785-786` — fragment renders to reduced `type2DArray`, per-eye `MTLFXSpatialScaler` reconstructs to drawable via cached views. — Raymarch cost ~scale²; the primary GPU saving when engaged. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — gated on `resolutionScale < 0.999` (default 1.0). Wired and functional; not the default.

**MetalFX temporal upscaling preferred over spatial (Mac/iOS)** — `MacTemporalUpscaler.swift:163-192`; `RaymarchRenderView.swift:393-411` — motion-vector pass + `MTLFXTemporalScaler` accumulates Halton-jittered history using depth + per-pixel motion; spatial is fallback. — Better stability/detail than spatial at the same low scale → push render resolution lower. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — `resolutionScale < 0.985` (default 1.0), Mac/iOS only.

**Closed-loop GPU-time dynamic resolution** — `AdaptiveResolutionController.swift:82-106`; `RaymarchRenderView.swift:383,449-455` — EMA-smoothed measured GPU time steps scale ±0.05 with hysteresis (1.05/0.80 band) and asymmetric cooldowns (0.30s down / 0.90s up), floor 0.34, ceiling = user slider; `record()` only on upscaled frames. — Holds a 60fps GPU budget by shedding input pixels. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — Mac/iOS only; engages only when `resolutionScale < 0.985`. visionOS has no equivalent.

**Temporal input clamped to output/3** — `MacTemporalUpscaler.swift:22-24,73-80` — floors temporal input at `ceil(output/3)` so the lowest slider settings stay on the temporal (not spatial) path. — Keeps aggressive downscales on the higher-quality path. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (temporal path only).

**RCAS sharpening fused into the resolve pass + adaptive strength** — `Shaders.metal:2938-2984,3027-3032`; `RendererRenderSupport.swift:671-679` — 5-tap noise-adaptive sharpen inline in the MetalFX resolve; host ramps `rcasStrength = clamp((1-scale)/0.67)*0.95`; shader early-outs to a single nearest tap when 0. — Recovers upscale detail in an existing pass; skips the 5-tap when nothing to sharpen. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — runs only on the MetalFX resolve path (`resolutionScale<0.999`); near native it is skipped (MetalFX off anyway).

**16-px input bucketing + near-native (≥95%) skip** — `RendererRenderSupport.swift:809-838` — snaps MetalFX input to 16-px buckets; drops MetalFX entirely when input ≥95% of native. — Prevents per-slider-tick texture/scaler rebuilds and a no-benefit near-1× copy. — **STATUS: ✅ active as a guard** (runs whenever the upscale subsystem is evaluated).

**2-slot snapshot pool for slider oscillation** — `MetalFXManager.swift:95-132,159-192` — swaps a stashed `PooledSnapshot` (textures+scalers+views) instead of rebuilding both eyes when adjacent buckets ping-pong; re-primes depth history. — Eliminates per-drag reallocation hitches. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (only exercised under active sub-native dragging).

**Per-eye scaler + texture-view caching** — `MetalFXManager.swift:88-89,207-208,286-309` — views/scalers built once, reassigned (not reallocated) each frame. — Per-frame encode cost → pointer assignment. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (MetalFX engaged only).

**MetalFX texture/scaler reuse across frames** — `MacTemporalUpscaler.swift:85-98`; `MacSpatialUpscaler.swift:61-67` — `prepare()` early-returns when sizes match; only size changes rebuild. — Avoids allocation churn on the steady-state upscale path. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (upscale path only).

**Largest-drawable selection (visionOS 26)** — `RendererRenderSupport.swift:299-352` — picks the largest-area candidate from `queryDrawables()` so the app's `resolutionScale`+MetalFX is the single quality lever (no compositor double-downscale). — Avoids stacking two quality reductions. — **STATUS: ✅ active** on visionOS 26+ (call is on the hot path; benefit only when >1 candidate returned).

### Foveation

**Hardware foveated rasterization rate map (fragment/raster + resolve)** — `RendererRenderSupport.swift:250-258,699,748`; `MetalProjectApp.swift:18` — attaches `drawable.rasterizationRateMaps.first` to the direct render, MetalFX-input, and resolve descriptors; foveation requested in `ContentStageConfiguration`. — Gaze-tracked variable-rate shading reduces peripheral fragment invocations — **the single biggest GPU lever active by default on the visionOS fragment path.** — **STATUS: ✅ active** on visionOS fragment/raster (system rate map exists, sizes match). Deliberately **not** wired to the compute encoder (Metal compute can't take a rate map).

**In-kernel foveated step-budget reduction (compute)** — `Shaders.metal:1741-1750` — per-tile factor from the tile-center radius ramps `maxSteps` to 0.5× at corners beyond `r=0.35`, scaled by `foveationStrength`; fixed-center, not gaze-tracked, divergence-free. — Up to ~2× fewer peripheral fine-march steps. — **STATUS: ⛔ disabled** — doubly gated: requires `tileSize==8` (off by default) AND `foveationStrength>0` (defaults 0.0). When `strength==0` the block is skipped (`factor==1`). This is the known foveation-compute-gap.

**Buddhabrot system rasterization rate map** — `BuddhabrotRenderer.swift:866-868,1180-1182,1245-1247` — attaches the drawable rate map to the volume ray-march, 3DGS render, and clear passes. — Hardware foveation on the dominant Buddhabrot fragment cost. — **STATUS: ✅ active** on the live Buddhabrot path (when that mode is launched).

### Temporal / Reprojection

**Per-pixel temporal reprojection warm-start (compute)** — `Shaders.metal:1762-1821,2105-2124` — reprojects each pixel into the previous frame, samples prev-depth, refines once, sets `startT = prevDepth*0.9`; `SceneWithCacheFromStart` marches a tight window with 0.25× budget. — ~288-step fine march → ~30 for ~95% of static pixels. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — compute kernel only (`tileSize==8`, off by default); within that path, active after frame 0.

**Fragment-path temporal depth warm-start (`computeWarmStartT`)** — `Shaders.metal:2566-2580,2679-2722` — reprojects into prev-frame depth, marches a narrow window via `SceneWithCacheFromStart`; window-miss falls back to full march (never changes *what* is hit). — Several-hundred-step fragment march → ~5-10 for stable pixels. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — visionOS `fragmentShader` only, and only when MetalFX active (`resolutionScale<0.999`) + geometry stable + no spherical inversion. Compiled out on Mac.

**Per-frame warm-start runtime gate (`warmStartEnabled`)** — `Shaders.metal:2687`; `Renderer.swift:1084-1089` — returns -1 unless `warmStartEnabled==1`, set only when MetalFX depth history is valid and the geometry `WarmStartGate` allows; discrete changes hard-disable for a frame. — Prevents stale-history full-march fallbacks. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (rides the MetalFX fragment path).

**`SceneWithCacheFromStart` tight-window step-budget scaling** — `Shaders.metal:1320-1379` — `stepScale=0.25` for temporal starts (>1.0) vs 0.5 for coarse, `endT=startT+2`, floor 8. — ~5-10 steps for reprojected pixels vs 30-60. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (reached on the live quad-shared + compute paths every frame geometry is found, and the visionOS fragment warm-start path).

**Custom visionOS TAA accumulation (`taaResolve`)** — `Shaders.metal:2327-2441`; `VisionOSTAAManager.swift:103-148` — reprojects an rgba16F ping-pong history through prev VP using true per-pixel depth, variance-clamps, `mix(history,current,blend)`; accumulates Halton jitter for free super-sampling. — Super-sampling-quality detail at low render scale for one compute pass. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — runs only when MetalFX active (`resolutionScale<0.999`); not the default.

**Adaptive TAA blend factor by geometry state** — `Shaders.metal:2426-2437`; `RendererRenderSupport.swift:154-160` — blend 0.1 stable / 0.3 settling / 0.5 dynamic, forced 1.0 on reset/disocclusion. — Max history reuse when static, discards stale history in motion. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (TAA path only).

**Cooperative threadgroup tile load (sRGB-decode once)** — `Shaders.metal:2321-2355` — 16×16 group loads its 18×18 halo into threadgroup memory, decoding each texel once instead of ~9× per variance window. — ~9× fewer sRGB decodes + texture reads in the TAA pass. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (TAA path only).

**Closest-depth (reverse-Z) dilation for reprojection** — `Shaders.metal:2391-2403` — 5-tap cross keeps the nearest surface so silhouette pixels reproject with foreground motion and survive variance clamp. — Preserves edge history (avoids shimmer/re-march). — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (TAA path only).

**True-depth reprojection (head-translation correct)** — `Shaders.metal:2384-2421` — unprojects at real written depth UV→NDC→view→model→prev clip; validity-gated. — More pixels reuse history under head translation. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (TAA path only).

**32×32 supertile + 8×8 tile temporal depth seeds** — `Shaders.metal:1949-2005` — 9-tap (≥5 hits) / 5-tap (≥3 hits) prev-depth reads seed `tileStartT=0.6×nearest`, skipping the `SceneCoarse` march; gated on `temporalReprojectionEnabled && blendFactor<0.6`. — Avoids ~50 Map evals/tile when frame-to-frame history is coherent. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — compute path (`tileSize==8`) only, when not mid-gesture.

**Skip coarse march via history seed** — `Shaders.metal:2014-2074` — `SceneCoarse` runs only when neither tile nor supertile seed fired; per-pixel reprojection *tightens* (min) but does **not** skip. — Removes the coarse march on coherent-history frames. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (compute path only).

**Current-frame depth write for next-frame reprojection** — `Shaders.metal:2094-2095,2131-2133`; `Renderer.swift:1565-1573` — both empty-tile and shaded paths write `curDepthTexture` (hit = adjustedDist, miss = sentinel), ping-ponged each frame. — Enables the entire temporal-reprojection cascade. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (compute path only).

**Mac motion-vector reprojection pass** — `Shaders.metal:3119-3163`; `RaymarchRenderView.swift:476-495` — reconstructs world pos from depth, reprojects through un-jittered current/prev VP → screen-space motion for `MTLFXTemporalScaler`; background returns zero motion. — Feeds temporal upscaling without ghosting. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (Mac temporal path engaged).

**Halton (2,3) sub-pixel jitter** — `RaymarchRenderView.swift:414-428`; `Shaders.metal:1722-1723,2736-2779` — sub-pixel offset advanced per frame, baked into projection (Mac) or added to `fragCoord` (visionOS) for temporal accumulation. — Distinct sub-pixel coverage drives detail reconstruction above render resolution. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — the add executes every frame but `jitterOffset` is .zero unless TAA (visionOS, scale<0.999) or the Mac temporal scaler is active. **Compute path `jitterOffset` is hardcoded zero (latent there).** `fragmentShaderMono` add is latent-dead on Mac (Mac jitters via the projection matrix).

**TAA history ping-pong + warm-start validity gating; reset on engage/cut/param change** — `VisionOSTAAManager.swift:29-41,117-118`; `MacTemporalUpscaler.swift:49-51,172-175` — two histories alternate read/write; `needsReset`/`forceReset` discard accumulation after discontinuities (reset assigned before textures per newer SDK semantics). — Prevents reads of uninitialized/stale history (flashing/ghosting). — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (temporal/TAA paths).

**Direct-render fallback invalidates warm-start** — `RendererRenderSupport.swift:135-140`; `RendererCoreTypes.swift:117-131` — `WarmStartGate.invalidate()` on any non-depth-writing path (direct render, Buddhabrot, compute, MetalFX failure); MetalFX path records depth + advances history. — Keeps warm-start correct across path switches. — **STATUS: ✅ active** — this guard runs every frame on the default direct-render path (even though the warm-start *benefit* it protects is conditional).

**Depth output for async timewarp / ASW** — `Shaders.metal:132,287-291,2588-2590` — hits write `output.depth = z/w` (visionOS NDC already [0,1], passthrough); misses write far-Z. — Hands the compositor a correct depth buffer for head-pose reprojection between frames. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (default fragment path, every frame).

**Depth-edge-preserving / merged stereo depth resolve** — `Shaders.metal:3040-3092` — depth sampled nearest (preserve silhouettes); `formatConversionFragmentStereoMerged` writes color+depth in one invocation. — Keeps compositor reprojection faithful; merged path saves a second pass. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (MetalFX resolve path; merged built `try?`, falls back to two encoders).

**Reverse-Z perspective projection (precomputed)** — `RenderPrecompute.swift:17-29` — CPU builds reverse-Z [0,1] projection per frame. — Better depth precision for motion-vector/warm-start features. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — Mac/iOS only; visionOS uses the CompositorServices-supplied projection.

### Command-Encoding / Sync

**Double-buffered in-flight semaphore (`maxBuffersInFlight=2`)** — `Renderer.swift:159,783,848-851`; `RaymarchRenderView.swift:220,440-458` — `DispatchSemaphore(value:2)` gates submission; CPU encodes N+1 while GPU renders N; uniform buffer sized ×2 for disjoint slices. — Overlaps CPU encode behind GPU work (the GPU-bound steady state). — **STATUS: ✅ active** (both platforms). *(Mac variant uses a non-blocking `wait(timeout:.now())` to drop a frame rather than stall.)*

**Dynamic uniform ring-buffer with power-of-2 bitwise advance** — `RendererFrameLoopHelpers.swift:4-10`; `Renderer.swift:278-289` — one shared `storageModeShared` buffer holds N 256-byte-aligned copies; index advances via `(idx+1)&(N-1)`. — No per-frame allocation, no CPU/GPU contention, cheaper-than-modulo index. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Single command buffer per frame, deferred submission** — `Renderer.swift:746,986-987,1233-1236` — one `MTLCommandBuffer`, all encoders recorded into it, `startSubmission()` deferred until after CPU updates, single `encodePresent`+`commit`. — Minimizes submission overhead; keeps the GPU-visible window short. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**MTLResidencySet pre-validation + batched commits** — `Renderer.swift:751-756`; `RendererSetupAndSession.swift:7-43` — uniform/tile buffers committed resident once; new textures added with one `commit()`+`requestResidency()` only on recreation. — Cuts per-frame residency validation; avoids churn on steady-state frames. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (base buffers every frame; texture-batching portion conditional on MetalFX/compute being engaged).

**Single-pass stereo via vertex amplification** — `Shaders.metal:2724-2729`; `RendererRenderSupport.swift:57`; `RendererPipelineHelpers.swift:70` — one amplified draw renders both eyes via `amplification_id` + per-view mappings (cached, rebuilt only on view-count change). — Halves CPU encode + vertex-stage work vs two per-eye passes. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (visionOS stereo; Mac is single-view `fragmentShaderMono`).

**Explicit fragment→scaler fence (eager, reused)** — `Renderer.swift:357-361,1184-1188`; `RendererRenderSupport.swift:143` — render encoder `updateFence(after:.fragment)`, scaler waits on it; created once. — Fine-grained producer→consumer dependency without per-frame fence alloc or full barrier. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (consumed only on MetalFX-active frames; fence creation itself eager/unconditional).

**Merged single-encoder MetalFX color+depth resolve** — `RendererRenderSupport.swift:705-726`; `Renderer.swift:341-348` — one fragment writes color(0)+depth(any) when the merged pipeline (built `try?`) exists, else two encoders. — Saves an encoder, a depth tile load/store, and a second fullscreen draw. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (MetalFX active + merged pipeline built).

**Buddhabrot in-order single command-buffer chaining** — `BuddhabrotRenderer.swift:665-667,1273-1324` — clear→accumulate→normalize→march (or emit→depth-keys→sort→render) all on one command buffer, no `waitUntilCompleted`/fence. — Metal serializes encoders in order; no host round-trip stalls. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (both Buddhabrot modes).

**Off-render-thread GPU profiler + async screenshot** — `Renderer.swift:1611-1713`; `RendererLoopSupport.swift:30-40` — profiler's blocking `await cmdBuffer.completed()` runs in a detached `.utility` Task; screenshot resumes a continuation via completion handler. — Keeps diagnostic GPU work off the per-frame path. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (one-shot, button-triggered).

### Memory / Bandwidth

**Drop `.shaderWrite` on spatial output (lossless compression)** — `MetalFXManager.swift:271-277` — output usage `[.shaderRead,.renderTarget]` only, enabling framebuffer compression. — ~1.5-3 MB/eye + reduced write/read bandwidth (driver-dependent prerequisite). — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (MetalFX engaged).

**Memoryless/private depth target, depth store skipped** — `RaymarchRenderView.swift:584-595,711-746`; `MetalFXTextureSupport.swift:30-37` — render-only depth uses `.memoryless` (iOS) / `.private` (Mac); `storeAction=.dontCare` except where the motion pass needs it. — Keeps depth in tile memory; skips DRAM write-back when unconsumed. — **STATUS: ✅ active** on the native direct path (depth-store-skip); memoryless branch is iOS + spatial-path + sub-native only.

**Aspect-correction folded into resolve UV** — `Shaders.metal:3020-3022,3053-3055` — in-shader `uv.x` rescale about 0.5, guarded by `!=1.0`. — Handles foveated physical-texture squish without a dedicated rescale pass. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (MetalFX resolve, aspect-mismatched textures).

**Non-sRGB writable-twin temporal output** — `MacTemporalUpscaler.swift:29-33,62-68` — compute-written output in `bgra8Unorm` (sRGB can't be compute-written), blit handles the linear round-trip. — Keeps output 8-bit; avoids a conversion pass. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (Mac temporal path).

**Residency-set registration to skip per-frame validation** — `RendererRenderSupport.swift:895-904` — adds (re)created MetalFX textures to an `MTLResidencySet` only on `resolutionChanged`. — Compositor skips per-frame residency validation. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (visionOS 2.0+, MetalFX texture (re)alloc).

**Cheap nearest-sample Mac blit to drawable** — `Shaders.metal:3113-3117` — final present is a single nearest tap, single-view. — Minimum-cost image move to drawable. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (Mac upscaled paths only; native path writes the drawable directly).

### CPU Host

**CPU-precomputed fractal/lighting/fog/audio params** — `Shaders.metal:205-224,443-465`; `RenderPrecompute.swift:32-164`; `RendererGameState.swift:148-185` — `makePrecomputed*` compute scale/`absScalePow=pow(|scale|,1-iters)`/`1/sphereRadius²`/animated light/audio aggregates/inverse fog ONCE per frame on CPU; shaders read them. — Removes per-pixel `powr()`/divides/`normalize`/`sin()` from a multi-million-pixel shader — a large ALU/transcendental saving. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (both platforms, every frame; `lightingWave` hoisted out of the per-eye loop on visionOS).

**Smoothed `maxViewDistance` trace-horizon clamp** — `RendererGameState.swift:108-118`; `RaymarchRenderView.swift:1067-1084` — zoom-derived, per-family-capped (Kleinian 420 / else 80), exp-smoothed; bounds the march far distance. — Rays terminate earlier when zoomed in, cutting void Map evals. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (consumed by the `t > maxRayDistance` march break on both platforms).

**Smoothed model scale** — `RaymarchRenderView.swift:260,1056-1069` — `smoothedScale` follows `settings.scale` via exp blend, driving `effectiveScale`/`traceScale`/view-distance. — Avoids abrupt march-range jumps (and the temporal invalidation they'd trip). *(Does not gate pipeline recompiles — the specialized key has no scale term.)* — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Scale-corrected safety-bubble radius** — `RendererGameState.swift:208-211` — radius/fadeWidth divided by `effectiveScale` on CPU so bubble geometry stays world-constant. — Hoists a divide; minor per-pixel saving. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (value just unused when bubble off).

**Mandelbulb safety-bubble disable** — `RendererGameState.swift:237-244`; `RaymarchRenderView.swift:1155-1159` — forces `safetyBubbleEnabled=0`/`strength=0` for Mandelbulb (a runtime uniform branch, not FC DCE). — Skips bubble blend/fade ALU for that formula. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (Mandelbulb only).

**Frame deltaTime clamping** — `RaymarchRenderView.swift:750` — `dt = max(1/240, min(now-last, 1/15))`. — Bounds interpolation/animation cost after a hitch/resume; prevents a giant smoothing step that would also trip temporal reset. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Conditional device-anchor query** — `Renderer.swift:809-817` — `queryDeviceAnchor` only when `worldTracking.state==.running`. — Skips a per-frame ARKit query when it would return nothing. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Off-actor hand-tracking dispatch coalescing** — `RendererFrameLoopHelpers.swift:56-156` — Mutex-gated single-in-flight MainActor gesture Task; accumulates delta if one is running; throttles `@Observable` writes to ~15Hz. — Keeps the render loop off MainActor; prevents gesture-Task backlog + SwiftUI invalidation storms. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**UI / parameter update coordinators (rate-limited, single-flight MainActor)** — `UIUpdateCoordinator.swift:74-131`; `ParameterUpdateCoordinator.swift:55-110` — FPS 2Hz, analytics 4Hz, head-height 2Hz; animation 90Hz, audio 60Hz — coalesced under a Mutex, one outstanding `@MainActor` Task. — Removes per-frame (90Hz) MainActor hops + `@Observable` churn during heavy rendering. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (head-height portion is a no-op on Mac/iOS — caller passes nil).

**Dedicated high-priority render-thread executor** — `RendererTaskExecutor.swift:18-79`; `Renderer.swift:552` — persistent `userInteractive` thread with a Mutex ring-buffer job queue (head-index dequeue + compaction). — Avoids DispatchQueue thread-hopping micro-stutters; O(1) hot-path dequeue. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (visionOS).

**Per-frame actor yield + cooperative idle sleep** — `RendererLoopSupport.swift:4-46` — `await Task.yield()` per iteration drains queued actor jobs; 50ms sleep when inactive/paused; `renderFrame` in an autoreleasepool. — Prevents pipeline-build deadlocks behind the loop; avoids spinning when idle. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Cached mesh vertex bindings** — `Renderer.swift:243-249,449-453`; `RaymarchRenderView.swift:346-350,564-573` — `MDLVertexBufferLayout` enumeration + casts done once in init, stored as `CachedMeshBinding`. — Removes per-frame descriptor traversal from the encode hot path. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (both platforms).

**Pipeline-selection fast-path memoization** — `RendererPipelineCache.swift:446-461,804-810`; `Renderer.swift:681-694` — compares all selection params vs last frame, returns the memoized pipeline without string interpolation/dict lookup. — Avoids per-frame String alloc + Dictionary hash on the stable steady state. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (render fast-path on the default path; compute fast-path conditional on `tileSize==8`).

**Settings snapshot (one lock per frame)** — `RaymarchRenderView.swift:785-787`; `RenderSettings.swift:1916-1917`; Buddhabrot `BuddhabrotRenderer.swift:265-289,1268` — one `withLock`/`os_unfair_lock` copies all fields into an immutable snapshot read lock-free. — Avoids dozens of per-accessor lock acquisitions on the render thread. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (covers the uniform-build portion; earlier per-frame code still hits live locked settings).

**Per-frame compute pipeline selection fast-path / cached anchor** — `RendererPipelineCache.swift:804-810`; `BuddhabrotRenderer.swift:1438-1445` — last-tuple memoization for compute; Buddhabrot caches the world-anchor transform once and never recomputes per head pose. — Skips per-frame key build / placement recompute. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (Buddhabrot anchor when that mode runs; compute fast-path on `tileSize==8`).

**Tilt sensor started/stopped on demand** — `RaymarchRenderView.swift:997-1013` — `setActive(enabled)` per frame, early-returns when tilt off/unavailable. — No idle CoreMotion polling when the feature is off. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (gate); sensor work conditional on the toggle.

**Audio-reactive work skipped outside audio mode** — `RaymarchRenderView.swift:759-778,902-906,966-974` — `isAudioMode`/`hasActiveAudioSources` computed once; band aggregation/LFO/dispatch early-return otherwise. — Skips the whole audio-reactive parameter path when off. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Render-loop gating on app-active / valid drawable** — `RaymarchRenderView.swift:360-366` — `draw()` early-returns unless app active + valid drawable; paced 60fps loop. — Skips all encode when backgrounded/invalid. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Slow-frame log permit throttle** — `RendererRenderSupport.swift:230-236` — perf diagnostics gated behind a 30ms frame threshold AND 0.5s spacing. — Keeps the completion-handler perf path free of string formatting on healthy frames. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

### Audio Real-Time

**Audio FFT off the render thread (MainActor hop) + owned-buffer copy** — `AudioAnalyzer.swift:269-304,306-412` — the real-time tap block only `memcpy`s into an owned `AVAudioPCMBuffer` then hops to a `@MainActor` Task for the FFT; renderer reads smoothed scalars via `nonisolated(unsafe)`. — Keeps the audio callback allocation-light (no HAL-buffer retention across the async boundary); FFT off the render thread (runs on MainActor). — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**MainActor dispatch batching for audio levels** — `AudioAnalyzer.swift:326-331,401-424` — stores latest pending levels; schedules `drainPendingLevels` only when none pending; subsequent buffers overwrite. — Collapses ~86 callbacks/s into ≤1 in-flight Task. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**vDSP/Accelerate FFT pipeline** — `AudioAnalyzer.swift:316-398` — RMS/window/DFT/magnitude/normalize/band-sum all via Accelerate SIMD on preallocated buffers. — Vectorized 2048-pt FFT cheap enough to run frequently. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Precomputed FFT setup, window, band-bin indices** — `AudioAnalyzer.swift:60-77,188-220` — DFT setup, Hann window, bass/mid/treble bins computed once (recomputed only on sample-rate change). — Removes per-frame DFT-setup/window/band arithmetic. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Cached attack/decay smoothing factors** — `AudioAnalyzer.swift:86-100,436-459` — four `1-exp(-speed·dt)` factors recomputed only when `dt` changes >0.001s. — Avoids 4 `exp()` per audio frame when timing is stable. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Silence RMS gate** — `AudioAnalyzer.swift:106,319-333` — when `RMS < 0.0015`, set levels to 0 and dispatch without running the FFT/band analysis. — Skips the entire FFT on silent input; prevents noise-floor flicker. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

### Buddhabrot (Progressive Monte-Carlo)

**Per-frame batched accumulation (progressive)** — `BuddhabrotRenderer.swift:686-728` (volume), `933-961` (default splat) — dispatches only `batchesPerFrame` (2) × `batchSize` (65536) seeds/frame, building the density grid / splat buffer incrementally; explicit thermal throttle. — Bounds per-frame cost of an O(huge) integral. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — the cited volume-mode code runs only in Volume Ray March mode; the structurally identical **default-active** batching lives in `encodeSplatEmission`.

**Bounded thread-private orbit buffer + escape cull** — `BuddhabrotShaders.metal:120-161,536-555` — `float3 orbit[256]` stack array, loop bound `min(maxIters,256)`; only escaped orbits scatter (`if(!escaped) return`). — Keeps iteration in registers; skips scatter for non-contributing seeds. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (used by the default `buddhabrotEmitSplats` kernel).

**Ring-buffer splat append (power-of-2 cap) + GPU 4-pass radix sort** — `BuddhabrotShaders.metal:570-572`; `BuddhabrotRenderer.swift:1037-1106` — splats appended mod `maxSplatCount=524288` (power-of-2); depth-sorted on-GPU via 4-pass 8-bit/256-bin radix with ping-pong buffers (even passes land back in A, no copy-back). — Bounds memory + per-frame sort; keeps the sort off CPU for correct alpha-over 3DGS. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (default splat path).

**Shared single-eye sort order for stereo** — `BuddhabrotShaders.metal:608-642`; `BuddhabrotRenderer.swift:1302-1312` — depth keys computed once from the left-eye view; order reused for both eyes (small IPD). — Halves depth-key + sort work for stereo. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**3DGS covariance/conic culling + transfer-function-at-emit** — `BuddhabrotShaders.metal:557-574,841-851,999-1005` — behind-camera clip, 1024px radius clamp, fragment discard at `power<-4`/`alpha<1/255`; palette color packed once into a `uint32` at emit (render only unpacks). — Avoids zero-contribution blends; moves transfer-function math out of the per-frame path + halves color bandwidth. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Threadgroup-local atomic histogram/scatter + single-thread prefix-sum** — `BuddhabrotShaders.metal:685-708,724-743,761-778` — radix histogram/scatter use threadgroup atomics (on-chip) with one device write-out; prefix-sum runs single-thread (1×1×1) to avoid inter-group sync. — Keeps hot atomic traffic on-chip; trades parallelism for zero scan-sync. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Direct shared-counter splat-count read** — `BuddhabrotRenderer.swift:1275-1286` — reads the splat count directly from the `.storageModeShared` atomic counter (written by completed prior-frame GPU) instead of waiting on the completion handler. — Removes 1-frame splat-count lag without a GPU sync. — **STATUS: ✅ active** (the `completedSplatCount` handler is vestigial — written, never read).

**Empty-frame passthrough fast path** — `BuddhabrotRenderer.swift:1290-1291,1232-1257` — `activeSplatCount==0` → `encodeClearFrame` emits a clear-only pass (no march/sort). — Skips all heavy passes; compositor shows passthrough. — **STATUS: ✅ active.**

**Throttled normalization (every N frames) + warmup ramp + sampled max-density scan + private volume + trilinear filtering + front-to-back early exit + AABB clip** — `BuddhabrotRenderer.swift:769,1330-1333,1399-1407`; `BuddhabrotShaders.metal:158,331-457` — all the Volume-Ray-March-mode levers (atomic density buffer, ~4× normalization throttle after a 120-frame warmup, strided max-density scan, GPU-private trilinearly-filtered volume, alpha-saturation early exit, AABB discard). — Bound the volume-mode GPU/CPU cost. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** — Volume Ray March mode only (default is Gaussian Splats).

### Instrumentation (no live frame savings)

**Diagnostic profiling kernels + DEBUG benchmark manager** — `ProgressiveShaders.metal:127-307`; `BenchmarkManager.swift:1-79` — `diagnosticKernel` (6 modes, forced iters/steps) measures optimization-lever costs; `BenchmarkManager` (`#if DEBUG`) accumulates per-fractal GPU/CPU stats. — Profiling aids only; feed no closed-loop controller. — **STATUS: 🟡 conditional** (profiler reachable via UI button); benchmark **⛔ disabled** (compiled out of release, no-op until manually toggled in DEBUG).

## 3. Latent / Dead / Disabled Optimizations

These exist in code but are **not buying performance** in the current/default state. Each entry gives the one fact that would activate it.

- **Bounding-sphere empty-space skip** — `Shaders.metal:276-285,1256-1268,1918-1943`; `BuddhabrotShaders` n/a. **💀 latent-dead everywhere.** `boundingSphereRadius>0` is never true: `estimatedBoundingSphereRadius` returns 0.0 (`RenderSettingsSnapshot.swift:82-84`, "Disabled until the bound is calibrated") **and** the compute uniform is a hardcoded literal `0.0` (`Renderer.swift:1320`), and Mac passes the 0-returning snapshot (`RaymarchRenderView.swift:1169`). **Activate:** compute a real bound AND change both the snapshot property and the `Renderer.swift:1320` literal.

- **In-kernel foveated step-budget reduction (compute)** — `Shaders.metal:1741-1750`. **⛔ disabled.** Requires `tileSize==8` (no default/bundled scene uses 8) AND `foveationStrength>0` (defaults 0.0). **Activate:** select the 8×8 compute renderer AND raise the foveation slider. (This is the known foveation-compute-gap — gaze never reaches the kernel.)

- **Coherent-packet warm-start probe + shadow normal-coherence gate** — `Shaders.metal:1823-1886,2188-2205`. **⛔ disabled.** `FC_COHERENT_PACKET` baked false on specialized compute pipelines and `coherentPacketEnabled` defaults false; host kernel is off-default anyway. **Activate:** `tileSize==8` AND enable the experimental coherent-packet toggle.

- **Runtime `quality` scaling levers (hit threshold, step ceiling, color iters)** — `Shaders.metal:1274-1275,1289-1291,897-898`. **💀 latent-dead.** Every call site passes `quality=1.0` (`fragmentMain:2548` is a hardcoded local; compute `2119/2122`), so all `(1-quality)`/`*quality` terms vanish. The renderer scales work via function constants, not this float. **Activate:** pass a `quality<1` from a call site — but the FC path supersedes it, so this is effectively vestigial.

- **`kMinQualityForShadows` (0.25) shadow skip** — `Shaders.metal:1594`. **💀 latent-dead** — never fires because `quality` is pinned to 1.0. The live shadow-skip trigger is the FC_QUALITY_MODE≥2 path instead.

- **Mandelbox finite-difference normal sub-branch** — `Shaders.metal:1116-1128`. **💀 latent-dead in practice** — every Mandelbox cache sets `hasJacobian=true`, so `GetNormal` always takes the analytic Jacobian path first. (The non-Mandelbox sub-branch at 1129-1141 *is* live.)

- **Buddhabrot `minIterations` escape-band sub-cull** — `BuddhabrotShaders.metal:139-144`. **💀 latent-dead** — the only call site hardcodes `uniforms.minIterations=0` (`BuddhabrotRenderer.swift:694`), so `i>=0` is always true and the rejection never fires. **Activate:** pass a non-zero `minIterations`.

- **Compute-path Halton sub-pixel jitter** — `Shaders.metal:1722-1723`; `Renderer.swift:1329`. **💀 latent** — `TileUniforms.jitterOffset` is hardcoded `.zero`, so the advertised "free supersampling via temporal integration" never happens on the compute path (only the IGN start-dither de-bands there). **Activate:** feed a non-zero Halton jitter into `TileUniforms`.

- **`fragmentShaderMono` jitter add (Mac)** — `Shaders.metal:2757`; `RaymarchRenderView.swift:1177`. **💀 latent-dead on Mac** — `jitterOffset` is always `.zero` (Mac jitters via the projection matrix instead). The add is a no-op there.

- **Floor-circle overlay (Mac)** — `Shaders.metal:2657-2663`; `RaymarchRenderView.swift:1179-1180`. **💀 latent-dead on Mac** — `floorCenterRadius` hardcoded to zero radius → `floorHit.alpha` always 0. Live only on visionOS.

- **`completedSplatCount` completion handler** — `BuddhabrotRenderer.swift:965-973`. **💀 latent-dead/vestigial** — written but never read; the direct shared-counter read supersedes it.

- **MetalFX / TAA / fragment warm-start stack** — `MetalFXManager`, `VisionOSTAAManager`, `Shaders.metal:2566-2580`. **⛔ disabled by default.** All gated on `resolutionScale<0.999` (default 1.0). **Activate:** lower the resolution slider / load a preset with sub-native scale. (Fully wired and functional — just not the default.)

- **Entire adaptive 8×8 hierarchical compute path** — `Shaders.metal:1688-2097`; `RendererRenderSupport.swift:214-226`. **⛔ disabled by default.** Selected only when `tileSize==8`; default `_tileSize=0` (`RenderSettings.swift:124`). All of its sub-techniques (per-pixel reprojection, tile/supertile seeds, tile-empty 5-ray skip, shared tile shadows, in-kernel foveation, coherent packet) ride this gate. **Activate:** set `tileSize=8` in a preset/quality config.

- **Quad-shared (2×2) fragment pipeline** — `Renderer.swift:304-316`; selected at `tileSize==2`. **⛔ disabled by default.** Prebuilt but latent. **Activate:** `tileSize==2`.

- **Startup compute-pipeline prewarming** — `RendererPipelineCache.swift:667-700`. **🟡 work-spent-but-unused** — the prewarm machinery runs at startup, but the kernels it warms only feed the `tileSize==8` path, which most sessions never select. Effort is spent on a path the default config never hits.

---

## 4. Notable Gaps / Opportunities

- **Foveation does not reach the dominant compute lever (when compute is used).** The system gaze-tracked `MTLRasterizationRateMap` is bound only to fragment/raster/MetalFX-resolve descriptors; the 8×8 compute kernel uses its own hand-rolled, **fixed-center, non-gaze** `foveationStrength` falloff (`Shaders.metal:1744-1746`), which is itself off by default. On the default path foveation *is* active (hardware rate map on the fragment encoder), but if a user opts into the compute renderer they lose gaze-tracked foveation entirely. Wiring gaze direction into `TileUniforms` would close this gap.

- **The most sophisticated raymarch optimizations are off the default path.** The hierarchical 8×8 cascade with its 3-8× claimed Map-eval reduction (temporal reprojection, tile-empty skip, shared shadows, coarse/continuous half-precision DE) is entirely gated behind `tileSize==8`, which no bundled scene sets. The default fragment path gets none of it. If the compute path is genuinely faster on Vision Pro, making it (or a preset that selects it) the default — or porting its temporal-reprojection warm-start onto the fragment path independent of MetalFX — is the largest untapped win.

- **Bounding-sphere void-skip is dead in two places at once.** It is hardcoded 0 in both the snapshot computed property *and* a `Renderer.swift:1320` literal, so even calibrating the bound would not revive it without editing both. Given fractals have computable bounds, this is a real "dozens of void Map evals per ray" saving left on the table.

- **The shader `quality` float is vestigial dead weight.** Multiple branches (`(1-quality)` threshold widening, `*quality` step/color scaling, `kMinQualityForShadows`) are wired to a value that is hardcoded 1.0 at every call site. The renderer correctly scales work via function constants instead — but the dead `quality` plumbing adds confusion and a few never-taken branches. It could be removed.

- **Compute-path "free supersampling" is advertised but absent.** Comments at `Shaders.metal:1722/2732` claim free temporal supersampling via `jitterOffset`, but `TileUniforms.jitterOffset` is pinned to `.zero` (`Renderer.swift:1329`). On the compute path only the IGN start-dither de-bands; the Halton/TAA jitter is fragment-path-only. Either feed jitter into `TileUniforms` or correct the comments.

- **Mac misses a couple of small reuse wins the visionOS path has.** Mac calls `device.makeDefaultLibrary()` directly per specialized build (`RaymarchRenderView.swift:662`) instead of the cached `bundledDefaultLibrary`, and never bakes `FC_SHADOW_ITERATIONS`/`FC_QUALITY_MODE` (indices 1/4), so Mac shadow marches run at the unreduced 3-step/4.0-unit fallback. Minor, but a free convergence with the visionOS specialization.
